Lit up a smoke and sat down on my stairs
I watched the birds singing from their tree
and wondered why life can't be this simple for me
To live so free, a world with no restraints
To draw on an empty canvass with all these colored paints
Some peace of mind I find some a little inner peace
Then I'll look at what i've done my own masterpiece
I may be an artist but not quite like that
[crossed out: I could've have been]
I couldn't be a baseball player. I had the balls but
not the bat.

You know I lived in a camper once
It was kinda fun the first couple of months
Getting stoned and driving around
You could never get lost
And you could never find
Yeah... I lived in a camper once
You know I dated a stripper once
It was kinda fun the first couple months
We had our highs and lows
And our share of thrills
But before too long I ran outta bills
Yeah... I dated a stripper once
You know I was a councilor at a leper colony once
It was kinda fun the first couple of months
But I couldn't use some of the phrases
Normal people speak and hear
And like [?] give me your ear and [?] me a hand
Yeah... I was a councilor at a leper colony once

cards.summary: A handwritten poem on a single sheet of lined notebook paper.
cards.typed_words:
ON ANOTHER PLANE
Sit on my steps stare at a plane in the sky
Crash and burn two hundred thirty people die
Now I don't see things quite the same
Could have been me that was on that plane.
Talking about vacation, talking to my friend
Talking about work, talking about the end
Read in the paper there no remains found
Imagine the captain's voice saying
Smoke 'em if you got 'em
We're going down
Living is what happens only day to day
You can see how quick it all fades away
